Windows one-file release of VBA Add-in Editor. The ZIP contains `VBAAddinEditor.exe` and its SHA-256 checksum file.

## Custom ribbon icons

Give any ribbon button your own picture instead of a built-in Office icon.

- In your browser, right-click a picture and choose **Copy image**. In the **Ribbon & XML** tab, put the cursor on a button (or a menu, group, or another control that can show an icon), right-click and choose **Set Icon from Clipboard**. **Set Icon from File…** works the same way with an image file.
- **Add Ribbon Button** and the new **Group into Menu** form have **Paste Image** and **Browse…** buttons with a preview.
- The picture is trimmed, centred on a transparent square and saved as a 32×32 PNG of a few KB, so the add-in loads as fast as with a built-in icon.
- The editor adds the image to the file, links it to the ribbon and registers the PNG type. One Undo reverts all of it.
- Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, ICO and TIFF.

## Rearrange the ribbon

- **Move Up / Move Down.** Put the cursor on a button, menu, group or tab in the ribbon XML and press **Alt+Up** / **Alt+Down**, click ▲ / ▼ above the part list, or right-click. Comments stay where they are. Controls whose position Office fixes (the dialog box launcher, the two halves of a split button) are not moved.
- **Group Selected into Menu.** Select some buttons in the ribbon XML, right-click and choose a label and icon. The buttons are wrapped in a new menu. Their size setting is removed, because buttons inside a menu cannot have one.
- These actions are also in the **Ribbon** menu.

## Safety

- A save can now add new files to the add-in, but only the icon images and link file you added. Each must match your edit exactly and must not already exist. Every other part of the file is still verified unchanged.
- Saves that only change the ribbon still leave the VBA project untouched.
- Unsaved icons are kept by crash recovery and by undo/redo.

## Notes

- The exe is about 1.8 MB larger: it now includes Pillow, which handles the images. Pillow is loaded only when you use an icon.
- If you replace an icon that is already saved, the old image stays inside the file, unused.
- This is a development build, built and tested on GitHub's Windows runner. It has not been through the live Excel/PowerPoint qualification matrix, and the new icon files have not yet been opened in Office. Keep the automatic backup on.
- Known bug: a module whose code starts with a blank line fails save verification ("Body mismatch"). The original file is left untouched; remove the leading blank line and save again.
- Password-protected VBA projects remain read-only.
